title: Mixing: Going Down On Love, Whatever Gets You Thru The Night, What You Got, Surprise, Surprise (Sweet Bird Of Paradox) by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

The first mixing session for John Lennon’s Walls And Bridges album was held on 20 August 1974.

Four songs were mixed in stereo: ‘Going Down On Love’, ‘Whatever Gets You Thru The Night’, ‘What You Got’, and ‘Surprise, Surprise (Sweet Bird Of Paradox)’.
